items.enrichment: Reported by the county's news source of record; full margin detail arrives with the board of elections canvass.
items.headline: NY-21 congressional race called for Constantino
items.what: North Country Now reported the NY-21 House race called, keeping the seat Republican as statewide results came in on election night.
items.why: Election Day. The call closes the county's most-watched race of the cycle.

items.enrichment: Reported by local news the same day.
items.headline: Benefit concert raises $8,000 for North Country Children's Museum
items.what: A benefit concert raised $8,000 for the North Country Children's Museum in Potsdam.
items.why: Fundraising for the museum's programs; the total was reported by local news the same day.

items.enrichment: A vice-president-level vacancy. Clarkson's organization chart now shows an interim CIO in place; the follow-up to watch is a permanent appointment.
items.headline: Clarkson's VP for Information Technology & Libraries seat is vacant

updates.text: Weekly audit re-check: Clarkson's organization chart now lists an Interim CIO of the Office of Information Technology. No permanent successor named; re-check by Nov 16.

items.what: Clarkson's Vice President for Information Technology & Libraries seat is vacant following Joshua Fiske's removal. Clarkson's current organization chart now lists an Interim CIO for the Office of Information Technology; no permanent successor has been named.
items.why: A vice-presidential departure touches every system on campus — IT, library, and the services staff use daily. The open seat is the story until an interim is named.

items.enrichment: Construction milestone at the campus's athletics and recreation hub.
items.headline: Maxcy Hall renovations nearing completion at SUNY Potsdam
items.what: Renovations at Maxcy Hall, SUNY Potsdam's athletics and recreation hub, are nearing completion.
items.why: Maxcy is the campus's main gym and pool complex; its reopening restores a facility the public uses as well as students.

items.enrichment: Reported by the university; the garden is open to the public.
items.headline: WISER Botanical Garden opens at SUNY Potsdam
items.what: The WISER Botanical Garden has opened at SUNY Potsdam, a new teaching and public garden space on campus.
items.why: A new public-facing campus space — part teaching garden, part community amenity.

items.enrichment: The closest skiing to Potsdam. Outside listings project a Dec 5 opening; the hill's own trail report was last updated Nov 4, with open-terrain counts still to come once the season starts.
items.headline: Titus Mountain begins posting trail reports ahead of opening

updates.text: Weekly audit re-check: outside listings (OnTheSnow, SnowStash, SkiCentral) still show a projected Dec 5 opening and the last trail report is still the Nov 4 one; nothing newer from the hill. Closed — the next hard signal is the opening itself.

items.what: Titus Mountain has started publishing daily trail and lift reports ahead of its season opening — the first of the area's ski hills to do so this year.
items.why: Trail reports are the season's first hard signal for winter tourism in the northern county; lodging, rentals, and weekend traffic follow within weeks.
